admission_budget.subject: the 64-input client-wall overrun measured in plan 11-04 (11-GRAVITON-EVIDENCE.json)
admission_budget.scope: The 64-input client-wall overrun (31.7 to 38.9 s on the measured samples) is accepted as a known condition, not a blocker.
reasons: mixed CPU: the measurement ran on both 0xd0c and 0xd40
expected Graviton 3 growth in the future
admission_budget.owner_reply: The slightly above cap is acceptable, as we have the mixed CPU, and we can expect more Graviton 3 in the future, and we know that in-account models are coming with latency tax, and the customers accept them.
